title: Ordinary native scalar counit categories and canonical mate formulas
statement: Fix the prime $\ell$, the finite-field datum $D$, and the normalized realization family of [def-sf-adic-realization-isomorphism-data]. For a geometric space $T$ let $\mathcal C_T$ be the full bounded constructible subcategory in its ordinary module derived category and let $\rho_T$ be the restriction of the recorded scalar realization to that essential image. For an underlying-scheme isomorphism $g$ use its actual function-normalized module pullback $P$ and the abelian fixed-pair category [def-weil-endofunctor-fixed-pair-category]. The termwise derived forgetful functor $U$ on ordinary derived categories [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] and $\mathcal W=U^{-1}\mathcal C_T$ are the section presentations of [def-sf-native-weil-derived-framework]. Their structure isomorphism $UP\cong U$ is the localization of the actual fixed-pair structure transformation. Restrict pullbacks and compact support to full constructible subcategories when their preservation witnesses have been supplied. The ambient compact-support functor is the actual sectionwise $Rp_*j_!$ with its canonical native coefficient identifications [lem-sf-locally-finite-adic-compact-support-realization]. Use the actual geometric fiber and compactification of [def-weil-frobenius-square-exchange]. An equivalence datum consists of an equivalence with forward functor exactly $\rho_T$; its realization bridge is this equality followed by the full-subcategory inclusion. For $F\dashv G$ and $a:QF\cong FP$, define $b:PG\to GQ$ by [def-weil-pbc-adjunction-mate] applied to $a^{-1}$. Define the mate-counit predicate by $\epsilon_{QL}F(b_L)=Q(\epsilon_L)a_{GL}^{-1}$, and the invariant-counit predicate by invertibility of $v=G(\theta)b_L$ and $\epsilon_LF(v)a_{GL}=\theta Q(\epsilon_L)$. Transport the adjunction through the two equivalences with their actual units and counits. Inverse reindexing cancellation is the localization of the family's function-normalized composition and identity comparisons, restricted to the full subcategory.
